objects: one complete-card-admitted physical spell card with fixed ordinary-mana Prowl
state_reads: source type and subtype snapshots at combat damage
state_writes: one selected alternative-cost marker and ordinary mana payment
costs: one fixed ordinary Prowl mana cost in place of the mana cost; ordinary increases and additional costs remain in the total
timing: the option is offered only after a source controlled by the caster dealt combat damage to an opponent this turn with a creature type shared by the spell
targets: spell targets remain independent from Prowl eligibility
choices: the caster may select the normal cost or Prowl when eligible
hidden_information: eligibility and the selected option are public
layers: current spell subtypes and the historical damage-source snapshot use canonical characteristic owners
replacement_effects: cost-generated zone moves continue through their canonical replacement owner
copy: copied, granted, and text-changed Prowl remain unsupported
control_change: damage history records the source controller at the damage event
zone_change: source history survives its later zone change; a stale spell offer cannot authorize a new incarnation
source_leaves: the source's combat-damage characteristic snapshot remains authoritative after it leaves

variants: one or more shared printed creature subtypes

implementation.supported_slice: One intrinsic fixed ordinary-mana Prowl declaration on a complete-card-admitted spell.

known_blockers: unrepresented or cyclic source and spell characteristic changes
variable, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, nonmana, copied, granted, text-changed, repeated, and incomplete-card forms
